purpose: Preserve and classify all associative-prefix kinds exposed by current upstream libdxfrw in LibreCAD diagnostic metadata.
trigger: The clean LibreCAD origin/master filter compile against the upstream libdxfrw overlay warned that four newer associative-prefix enum values were not handled by the metadata mapper.

implementation.behavior: The diagnostic adapter now maps AcDbAssocValueDependency, AcDbAssocDependencyBody, AcDbAssoc2dConstraintGroup and AcDbAssocVariable to distinct LibreCAD metadata kinds, names and counts. New count members are appended after existing fields to preserve their offsets; enum values are appended to preserve existing values.
implementation.scope: Diagnostic metadata transport only; no associative graph/output or semantic support claim.

validation.cleanFilterCompile: cmake --build /private/tmp/librecad-upstream-libdxfrw-check-build --target librecad_filter_compile_check -j6 PASS after the mapper change, with no associative-prefix switch warning.
validation.standaloneMetadataSmoke: Compiled against the clean overlay's CMake include/flag set, linked to the current upstream libdxfrw archive, then executed PASS. It maps all four kinds distinctly and checks prefix totals, per-kind counts and complete status counts.
validation.broaderTestTarget: The dedicated librecad_entity_metadata_tests target could not build because the existing entity_metadata_tests.cpp has unrelated DRW_TableCellAttribute initializer errors at earlier table-test sites against the upstream overlay API. The four-kind smoke test isolates and passes the changed mapper path.
validation.diffCheck: git diff --check on the two changed LibreCAD paths PASS.

compatibility.sourceStatus: The current upstream enum values are retained as four separate LibreCAD diagnostic categories; they are not collapsed into older kinds.
compatibility.binaryLayout: Existing count fields retain their original offsets because additions are appended. Full ABI compatibility remains unqualified.

limitations: No full LibreCAD application build or runtime test was completed.
No LibreCAD_3 application, binary ABI, Linux/Windows platform, or native associative behavior qualification follows.
The open P8 consumer/platform/release gate remains open.
supportClaimEffect: Removes the four-case upstream-enum mapper warning and preserves their diagnostic categories; does not promote DWG/DXF support claims.
